component.name: stable-diffusion.cpp (ROCm 10)
component.summary: Generate images and video locally with ROCm 10

description.p: Run diffusion models locally with the embedded browser interface, HTTP APIs, or command-line tools. This ROCm 10 edition is a community package of the official upstream Linux ROCm 10 build, repackaged unmodified.
This edition requires an AMD GPU supported by ROCm 10.1.0. It grants device access for ROCm compute through /dev/kfd and /dev/dri.
The desktop entry starts the server in a terminal. Open http://127.0.0.1:1237/ in your browser and keep the terminal open. Model weights are downloaded separately and follow their own licenses.

Place model files in category folders such as checkpoints, diffusion_models, text_encoders and vae under ~/.var/app/io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.ROCM10/data/models/. Relative CLI output is saved under ~/.var/app/io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.ROCM10/data/. Access to additional model directories is optional:

ul.li: Read models from Downloads: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-download:ro io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.ROCM10
Write output to Pictures: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-pictures io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.ROCM10

description.p: Use sd-cli through flatpak run --command=sd-cli io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.ROCM10, or pass server options through flatpak run io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.ROCM10. Each backend edition has its own model directory and browser origin.
